title: Invitations and accounts
description: Serves "Joining and signing in are easy and safe."; "They see only what they may.". Absorbs JS-033's account rules for the new API.
acceptanceCriteria: An invitation expires, has a use count, and grants exactly what the operator chose (JS-036's rule) and limits, never admin.
Revoking an invitation can remove everyone it brought in.
An administrator creates, disables and removes accounts, keeping JS-033's rules (the last administrator, revocation at once, password rules).
A single sign-on identity is never matched to an account by email alone.
Every capability it adds is in the published contract (JS-183) and passes its conformance check.
